title: Specify the canonical data model
acceptance: Defines language-neutral primitives (identifiers, timestamps, binary values, integers) and their canonical text forms.
Defines canonical serialization and the exact input to hashes and signatures, so two independent implementations produce identical bytes.
Defines extensibility: unknown-field handling, versioning fields and ordering rules.
Resolves RTM-O-13 (canonical serialization and hash) or records a deferral permitted by D-10.
